dialogue.origin: こんにちは、本日は宜しくお願い致します。ご準備できましたら、お知らせください。ロールプレイを開始させて頂きます。
dialogue.content: Hello, thank you for being here today. Please let me know when you're ready. We'll begin the role-play.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、大丈夫です。お願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm ready. Please go ahead.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。ではロールプレイを開始させて頂きます。
dialogue.content: Thank you. We will now begin the role-play.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどうされましたか？
dialogue.content: What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 主人が鬱っぽいんです。
dialogue.content: I think my husband might be depressed.

dialogue.origin: 年末から会社をちょこちょこ休むようになって。最近は週1寝込んでいます
dialogue.content: Since the end of the year, he's been taking occasional days off from work. Lately, he's been bedridden for about one day a week.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それはお悩みですよね
dialogue.content: That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうしたらいいか…
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm not sure what to do...

dialogue.origin: よろしければ、夫さんのことをもう少し詳しくお話していただけますか？
dialogue.content: If you're comfortable, could you tell me a little more about your husband?

dialogue.origin: はい、通勤電車の中で時々過呼吸になって、電車に乗るのが嫌みたいなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, he sometimes has hyperventilation attacks on the commuter train, and it seems he dislikes riding the train now.

dialogue.origin: 後、たまに死にたいと思うこともあるみたいで
dialogue.content: Also, it seems he sometimes thinks about wanting to die.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 病院受診も勧めるのですが、なかなか行かないし
dialogue.content: I suggest that he see a doctor, but he just won't go.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仕事は確かにしんどそうだので、あまりしんどかったら、配置換えを頼むとか、やめることも勧めるのですが、コロナの影響で転職も難しいみたいだし、だけど家の中では普通なんです
dialogue.content: His work certainly seems stressful, so I've suggested he ask for a transfer to a different department or even quit if it's too much. But with the pandemic, changing jobs seems difficult. And yet, at home, he acts normally.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 午後からやっと起きてくる感じだし。
dialogue.content: He finally gets up in the afternoon.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, yes.

dialogue.origin: それは夫さんも側でみられているあなたもお辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: That must be difficult for both your husband and for you, watching him go through this.

dialogue.origin: よろしければ、あなたの年代と呼び名を教えて頂いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age range and how you'd like to be addressed?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 40代　まい　です。
dialogue.content: I'm in my 40s. You can call me Mai.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんはかなりつらそうですが、お食事や睡眠はとられていますか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like your husband is having a very hard time. Is he eating and sleeping properly?

dialogue.origin: お酒を結構飲んでいて、遅くまで。午後からやっと起きてきます
dialogue.content: He drinks quite a bit and stays up late. He finally gets up in the afternoon.

dialogue.origin: 食欲もなさそうです。
dialogue.content: He doesn't seem to have much of an appetite either.

dialogue.origin: 鬱だと思うんですよね…
dialogue.content: I really think it's depression...

dialogue.origin: だから、
dialogue.content: So...

dialogue.origin: ええ、それはご心配ですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, I can see why you'd be worried.

dialogue.origin: 私も働いているので、主人が休んだ時は、夕方のゴミ出しとか洗濯物の取り入れをお願いする事もあります。
dialogue.content: I work as well, so when my husband takes a day off, I sometimes ask him to take out the trash in the evening or bring in the laundry.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 休む分、会社からの評価も下がるし、給料にも響くから、金銭的にも大変になって来るし。
dialogue.content: Because he's taking time off, his performance review at work will suffer, and it will affect his salary, so things are getting difficult financially.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.origin: 体調もあるけど、経済面でも不安です
dialogue.content: I'm worried about his health, but also about our finances.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、それは色々と不安や心配になりますよね。
dialogue.content: Of course. It's understandable that you would have many anxieties and worries.

dialogue.origin: どうしたものか…
dialogue.content: I just don't know what to do...

dialogue.origin: ええ、そう思ってしまいますよね・・まいさんもお仕事をされておられるとのことですが、夫さんのことは職場や友人とかどなたかにご相談されましたか？
dialogue.content: Yes, it's natural to feel that way. You mentioned that you work as well, Mai. Have you talked to anyone about your husband, like people at your workplace or any friends?

dialogue.origin: 主人は会社には伝えたと思いますが、私は、なかなか話せません。
dialogue.content: I think my husband has told his company, but I find it hard to talk about it myself.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね、簡単に人に話せることでもありませんよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. It's certainly not something that's easy to talk about with others.

dialogue.origin: 思いきって主人に仕事辞めてもらって、私が稼ぐ方が早いかとも思うんですが、
dialogue.content: I've even thought it might be better to just have my husband quit his job and for me to become the main earner,

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: 今は私がパートで行ってるけど、フルタイムで仕事すると、そんなに今の主人の給料と変わらないんです。
dialogue.content: I'm working part-time now, but if I worked full-time, my salary wouldn't be that different from my husband's current one.

dialogue.origin: 社会保険も加入しているから、主人や子供達を扶養に出来るし。
dialogue.content: I'm enrolled in social insurance, so I could have my husband and children as dependents.

dialogue.origin: ええええ、そのようなご事情もおありだったのですね。
dialogue.content: Oh, I see. So that is another part of your situation.

dialogue.origin: 主人は料理等家事が得意だし、主人の実家住みなので、家に居てもお姑さんといればいいし。
dialogue.content: My husband is good at cooking and other housework, and since we live with his parents, even if he's at home, he can be with his mother.

dialogue.origin: ただ、それを受け入れて来れるかどうかというのもあるし、ずっと家にいる方が、鬱という意味だと、よくないかもとも思います。
dialogue.content: But there's the question of whether he would accept that. And I also think that staying at home all the time might not be good for him, in terms of his depression.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そのように色々と考えておられるのですね
dialogue.content: Yes, I can see you've been thinking about this from many different angles.

dialogue.origin: 田舎なので、ご近所の目もあるし。
dialogue.content: We live in the countryside, so we have to think about what the neighbors will say.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、それもきになりますね
dialogue.content: I see, that's another concern.

dialogue.origin: 色々としんどいです
dialogue.content: It's all just very difficult.

dialogue.origin: ちょっと数日、休みで家にいるだけでも「仕事辞めたの？」とかいう人もいまず
dialogue.content: There are even people who, if you're home for just a few days off, will ask, "Did you quit your job?"

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、それだけ色々と抱えてお一人で考えてこられたらしんどくなるもの当然だと思います。
dialogue.content: Of course. It's completely understandable that you would feel overwhelmed, having carried all of this and thought about it by yourself.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、
dialogue.content: Yes, yes.

dialogue.origin: そんなこと言われると周囲の目を気にしてしまうのはあたりまえです。
dialogue.content: It's natural to be concerned about what others think when they say things like that.

dialogue.origin: はい、子供達も段々お金がかかる年齢なので
dialogue.content: Yes, and my children are getting to an age where they're starting to cost more money.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ちなみにお子さんはおいくつですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. By the way, how old are your children?

dialogue.origin: 中学1年と、5年です
dialogue.content: A first-year in junior high and a fifth-grader.

dialogue.origin: 私迄暗い顔をしていると、子供達によくないと思っているので、出来るだけ明るく過ごす様にしています。
dialogue.content: I feel that if I also look gloomy, it won't be good for the children, so I try to be as cheerful as possible.

dialogue.origin: それはこれからお金のかかる年代ですね・・
dialogue.content: Yes, those are ages where expenses will increase going forward...

dialogue.origin: おまけに
dialogue.content: On top of that...

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ
dialogue.content: Yes, go on.

dialogue.origin: 主人は糖尿病と、高血圧も抱えていて、負担はかけさせられそうにありません。
dialogue.content: ...my husband also has diabetes and high blood pressure, so I can't really burden him.

dialogue.origin: そのようなご事情も抱えておられたのですね。それは心配なことがたくさんありすぎて、
dialogue.content: So you were dealing with that situation as well. With so many things to worry about,

dialogue.origin: どうしたらよいかわからなくなるのは当然です。
dialogue.content: it's perfectly natural to not know what to do.

dialogue.origin: 今日は一緒に考えられたらと思います。
dialogue.content: I hope we can think about this together today.

dialogue.origin: なに科を受信すればよいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What kind of doctor should he see?

dialogue.origin: 受診、です
dialogue.content: I mean, for a medical consultation.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。鬱だと心療内科か精神科だとおもいますが、
dialogue.content: Let's see... If it's depression, it would be a psychosomatic medicine clinic or a psychiatrist, but...

dialogue.origin: 夫さんが受診を嫌がられているのようだと、まずは
dialogue.content: since your husband is reluctant to see a doctor, perhaps first...

dialogue.origin: 持病の内科を受診して、そこの先生から受診をすすめてもらうのはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: how about he visits his regular doctor for his chronic conditions, and you have that doctor recommend he see a specialist?

dialogue.origin: なかなか、行こうとしてくれないんですよね
dialogue.content: He's just so unwilling to go.

dialogue.origin: そうですか・・それは悩みどころですよね
dialogue.content: I see... That's a difficult situation.

dialogue.origin: お薬とかもらいには夫さんは行かれますか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband go to get his prescriptions filled?

dialogue.origin: 外出が嫌みたいで
dialogue.content: He seems to dislike going out.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのかかりつけ医はおられますか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband have a regular doctor?

dialogue.origin: 一応、元気なころは、行ってたことがあります
dialogue.content: Well, he used to go when he was feeling better.

dialogue.origin: ええ、それは一つ相談できるところになるかもしれないです。
dialogue.content: I see. That might be a place you can turn to for advice.

dialogue.origin: 元気といっても、検診でひっかかった時かな
dialogue.content: When I say 'feeling better,' I mean when he was flagged in a health checkup.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、それだとあまり関わったことがない感じですよね。
dialogue.content: I see, so he doesn't have a strong relationship with that doctor.

dialogue.origin: まいさんご自身はかかりつけのクリニックとかありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have a family clinic you go to yourself, Mai?

dialogue.origin: そういえば、最近、主人は、糖尿の受診をさぼっていたかもしれません
dialogue.content: Come to think of it, my husband may have been skipping his diabetes appointments lately.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、それはお体心配ですね。
dialogue.content: Is that so? That is concerning for his health.

dialogue.origin: 本人任せだったので
dialogue.content: I've been leaving it up to him.

dialogue.origin: ええ、それはそうだと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's understandable.

dialogue.origin: ではよければ、糖尿の受診をすすめてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Then, if it's okay, how about encouraging him to go for his diabetes checkup?

dialogue.origin: それなら行きやすいかもですが、
dialogue.content: He might be more willing to go for that, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes, go on.

dialogue.origin: 何しろ、ふさぎこんでて、私の声が届くか…
dialogue.content: He's just so withdrawn, I don't know if my words will reach him...

dialogue.origin: この前は、子供にあったてもいましたが。
dialogue.content: The other day, he even lashed out at our child.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そのようなこともあったのですね
dialogue.content: I see—so something like that happened as well.

dialogue.origin: どう扱っていいかわかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know how to deal with him.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、そのようなこともあったのなら戸惑ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, given that something like that happened, it's understandable to feel at a loss.

dialogue.origin: 子供のことも心配になってしまいます
dialogue.content: I'm becoming worried about the children, too.

dialogue.origin: ええ、それは母として当然だと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's completely natural as a mother.

dialogue.origin: 何か、打開策はありませんかね？
dialogue.content: Is there any way to break through this? A solution?

dialogue.origin: はい、これまでを整理するとまいさんは今日は夫さんの今の状態を悩んでおられますが、
dialogue.content: Yes. To summarize what we've discussed, Mai, you're worried about your husband's current condition, but...

dialogue.origin: よろしければ、一番今の状況の中で考えたいことはどのようなことか、お聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.content: if you would, could you tell me what the most important thing is that you want to focus on in this current situation?

dialogue.origin: それをまいさんと一緒に考えていきたいと思っています。
dialogue.content: I'd like to think that through together with you, Mai.

dialogue.origin: このままだと、子供の気持ちも不安になっていくだろうし、
dialogue.content: If things continue like this, I'm sure the children will start to feel anxious as well,

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ
dialogue.content: Yes, yes.

dialogue.origin: これからお金もかかるし、子供のために何ができるかな、と思います
dialogue.content: and with more expenses coming up, I'm wondering what I can do for the children.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。まいさんのご不安はとても伝わってきています。一緒にできることを考えていきましょう。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. I can really feel your anxiety, Mai. Let's think about what we can do together.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: はい、まず経済的な問題は、まいさんのパートをフルタイムになることでカバーできそうですか？
dialogue.content: Okay. First, regarding the financial issue, does it seem possible to cover it by you switching from part-time to full-time work?

dialogue.origin: それしかないかも。
dialogue.content: That might be the only way.

dialogue.origin: ええ、お話伺う限り夫さんが今すぐこれまでみたいに働くのは難しそうですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, from what you've told me, it seems difficult for your husband to work like he used to right now.

dialogue.origin: 厳しそうです
dialogue.content: It seems very difficult.

dialogue.origin: ただ、会社に休職届けを出してしばらくは少しでも給与を頂くことは、できそうですか？
dialogue.content: However, would it be possible for him to submit a leave of absence request to his company and receive at least some salary for a while?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。届け出は必要ですよね
dialogue.content: That's true. He would need to submit the request.

dialogue.origin: ええ、これまで夫さんも働いてこられたので、今の状態を会社に相談して何か対策を考えてもらうのも、
dialogue.content: Yes. Since your husband has worked there for a long time, consulting with the company about his current situation and having them consider some measures...

dialogue.origin: 今後の経済的な面では大きく左右するかなと思います。
dialogue.content: ...could make a big difference financially going forward.

dialogue.origin: 給与をもらえるかどうかは、わかりませんが、
dialogue.content: I don't know if he'll get paid, but...

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 届けはした方がいいですね
dialogue.content: it would be better to submit the request.

dialogue.origin: はい、少しでもまいさんの何か負担が減るかもしれないのでぜひそれも検討してみたくださいね。
dialogue.content: Yes, it might lessen your burden even a little, so please do consider that.

dialogue.origin: それと、お子さん達への心のケアも含めてですが、
dialogue.content: And also, regarding support for your children's emotional well-being,...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 糖尿でかかっている先生がおられるなら、一度その先生にお電話でも今の夫さんの状態をご相談するのも一つかと思います。
dialogue.content: If there is a doctor he sees for his diabetes, it might be a good idea to call that doctor and discuss your husband's current condition.

dialogue.origin: 電話ですか。
dialogue.content: By phone?

dialogue.origin: はい、夫さんが受診する前にあらかじめまいさんが電話でご相談して、それから夫さんの受診につなげると、まいさんのご負担もへるかと思い、
dialogue.content: Yes, I thought that if you called and consulted with the doctor beforehand, before your husband's visit, and then arranged for him to go, it might reduce your burden.

dialogue.origin: ご提案しました。電話でご相談できれば、お仕事されているまいさんでも時間のご負担も減るかと思いましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: That's why I suggested it. If you can consult by phone, I thought it would also be less of a time commitment for you, since you are working. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。それならできそうですが、
dialogue.content: That's true. That seems doable, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: ちゃんとその気になってくれるといいんですけど…
dialogue.content: I just hope he'll actually be willing to go...

dialogue.origin: ええ、その心配はありますよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's a valid concern.

dialogue.origin: うつ病だとしたら、夫さんの今の状態は夫さんの意志と関係なく、
dialogue.content: If it is depression, your husband's current state is not related to his own willpower.

dialogue.origin: 病気がそうさせているので、お子さんにあたったり、病院に行けないのも、その原因もあると思います。
dialogue.content: The illness is causing it, so I believe that's also the reason he took it out on your child and is unable to go to the hospital.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり、そうですよね…
dialogue.content: Yes... that's what I thought.

dialogue.origin: ええ、もしうつ病だとしたら、病気がそうさせています。なので、あらかじめ先生に相談して、先生から糖尿のお薬や検査を口実に、
dialogue.content: Yes, if it is depression, the illness is causing these behaviors. So, talking to the doctor in advance and having the doctor use the diabetes medication or a check-up as a pretext...

dialogue.origin: 受診に誘いだしてもらうのは、一つかと思います。
dialogue.content: ...to encourage him to come in for a visit is one option.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 少しご提案しましたが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: I've made a few suggestions. How do they sound to you?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。とにかく、何か行動に起こさないと始まりませんよね
dialogue.content: Thank you. In any case, nothing will start if I don't take some kind of action, right?

dialogue.origin: はい、少しでも行動して周囲に頼ることが、まいさんの心配や不安を減らしていくのには、大切だと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I think taking even a small action and relying on others is very important for reducing your worries and anxiety.

dialogue.origin: 電話なら、できますもんね
dialogue.content: A phone call is something I can do.

dialogue.origin: ええ、電話が時間的にもいいと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I think a phone call would be good in terms of time as well.

dialogue.origin: これまで夫さんの状態やお子さん、経済的なことと家族のために一生懸命にまいさんは頑張ってこられ、まいさんのご家族を思う優しさや、愛情を感じました。
dialogue.content: You've been working so hard for your family, dealing with your husband's condition, your children, and the finances; I can feel your kindness and love for your family, Mai.

dialogue.origin: けれどもし夫さんが病気だとしたら、家族だけでは抱え込むと辛いことも増えてくるので、ぜひ周囲の医療やここの相談窓口を利用しながら、
dialogue.content: However, if your husband is ill, trying to handle it all within the family can lead to more difficulties. So please, make use of the medical professionals and support services available to you, including this one,

dialogue.origin: 進めていってほしいと思い、まいさんの行動を応援しています。
dialogue.content: as you move forward. I support you in taking these steps.

dialogue.origin: これまでお話していかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel after talking about all of this today?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。やってみますね
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: はい、ぜひ応援しています。もし何かあればいつでもご相談くださいね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I am cheering for you. Please feel free to consult with us anytime if anything comes up.

dialogue.origin: それで、私が付き添っていけたらいいですね。
dialogue.content: Then, it would be great if I could go with him to the appointment.

dialogue.origin: どうもありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい、こちらこそほんじつはありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, and thank you as well for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: お世話になりました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.origin: これで本日のご相談を終了させて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I conclude today's session now?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした。少し時間をおしてしまい申し訳ありませんでした。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. I apologize for running a little over.)

dialogue.origin: 勉強になりました。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: This was a great learning experience. Thank you!

dialogue.origin: （とても勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。これでロールプレイを終了してよろしいでしょうか？）
